name: ats-platform
description: TalentOS ATS with Anti-Gravity Physics Engine

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.check-all: node scripts/check-list-architecture.js && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run check-syntax --prefix backend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:ci --prefix frontend && npm run test:unit --prefix backend
scripts.deploy:test: npm run check-all && npm run build:all && node scripts/deploy-test.js
